title: Evolving Creatives with Clicks: CTR-Driven Advertising image Editing via Attribute Disentanglement and Preference Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.13066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The optimization objective for e-commerce advertising creatives has shifted from aesthetic quality to online business metrics like click-through rate (CTR). Recent methods generate appealing ad images from product images by constructing CTR-based reward signals and refining prompt generation via Reinforcement Learning. Such paradigms equally penalize all attributes within an underperforming image, even though some are actually beneficial to clicks. In this work, we propose Evolving Creatives with Clicks (ECC), which reformulates creative optimization as fine-grained editing rather than generation from scratch. ECC selectively refines attributes that hurt CTR while preserving those that contribute positively. Specifically, faced with a rich attribute space across massive images, ECC first identifies 28 attributes significantly correlated with CTR via ANOVA and Random Forest regression. translated_abstract: 电子商务广告创意的优化目标已从美学质量转向点击率（CTR）等在线业务指标。近期方法通过构建基于CTR的奖励信号，并借助强化学习优化提示词生成，从产品图像生成吸引人的广告图像。然而这类范式会对表现不佳图像中的所有属性进行同等程度的惩罚，即使其中某些属性实际上对点击是有益的。在本工作中，我们提出了Evolving Creatives with Clicks（ECC），将创意优化重新表述为细粒度的编辑而非从零开始的生成。ECC选择性地改进损害CTR的属性，同时保留那些对点击有积极贡献的属性。具体而言，面对海量图像中丰富的属性空间，ECC首先通过方差分析（ANOVA）和随机森林回归识别出28个与CTR显著相关的属性。基于表现不同图像之间的属性对比……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ECC框架，将广告创意优化从整体生成转变为细粒度编辑，通过ANOVA和随机森林回归识别出28个与点击率显著相关的属性，实现属性解耦与偏好对齐，从而选择性地优化损害点击率的属性并保留有益属性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ECC, a CTR-driven ad creative optimization framework that reformulates generation as fine-grained editing, identifying 28 CTR-correlated attributes via ANOVA and Random Forest regression to selectively refine click-harming attributes while preserving beneficial ones through attribute disentanglement and preference alignment.
